name: MuSe 2022 Multimodal Sentiment Analysis Challenge
description: The Multimodal Sentiment Analysis Challenge (MuSe) 2022 is dedicated to multimodal sentiment and emotion recognition. For this year's challenge, we feature three datasets: (i) the Passau Spontaneous Football Coach Humor (Passau-SFCH) dataset that contains audio-visual recordings of German football coaches, labelled for the presence of humour; (ii) the Hume-Reaction dataset in which reactions of individuals to emotional stimuli have been annotated with respect to seven emotional expression intensities, and (iii) the Ulm-Trier Social Stress Test (Ulm-TSST) dataset comprising of audio-visual data labelled with continuous emotion values (arousal and valence) of people in stressful dispositions. reputation: MuSe is a well-known recurring affective computing challenge with established use in multimodal sentiment and emotion research.
notes: Includes multiple sub-challenges and datasets with different label types; metrics vary by track, and scores are not directly comparable across tasks.
